## Disclaimer

These are my personal dotfiles tailored specifically for my own machines. Don't clone and run the installer scripts expecting things to just work. Hardware, packages, and paths here are tuned for my setup and will probably break yours.

Feel free to take snippets or look around, but if you want an installable base, head over to [end-4/dots-hyprland](https://github.com/end-4/dots-hyprland) instead.
